xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: 1. Relationship of the counterparty with the listed entity (Asian Paints Limited) is reported. 2. Value of the transaction approved by the Audit Committee pertains to the entire financial year 2024-25 except remuneration, retiral benefits and contribution by the Company to various employee trusts. 3. The term 'subsidiary' includes step down subsidiaries of the Company. 4. Audit Committee's approval is not applicable for the Company's transactions with its wholly owned subsidiaries, transactions within two wholly owned subsidiaries, and transactions of subsidiaries with its related parties where value of transaction is less than 10% of the subsidiary's previous year's turnover. 5. Remuneration does not include stock options granted in accordance with the Asian Paints Employee Stock Option Plan 2021, which would vest after fulfillment of vesting conditions in accordance with the Plan. Remuneration reported pertains to the amount paid during the period including variable pay of previous year but does not include provisions towards variable pay, compensated absences and retiral benefits etc. It includes ESOP related perquisites for those options exercised during the period. 6. Reimbursements paid to employees as per company policy has not been covered above. 7. The Company has issued letters of awareness to banks/ financial institutions with respect to loans taken by certain international subsidiary companies. In this regard, there has been no guarantee given or provided to any related party. Hence, the same has not been included here in the balances as well as transactions. 8. Transactions between members of the Group (between Asian Paints Limited and its subsidiary or between subsidiaries) are reported once. 9. Difference in opening and closing balances is on account of transactions during the period / exchange rate fluctuation in case of foreign currency. 10. Amounts reported are inclusive of GST wherever applicable. 11. A P International Doha Trading W.L.L has been voluntarily liquidated on 26th November, 2024. 12. In accordance with SEBI circular issued during the year, corporate actions such as dividend, rights issue of share are not considered as related party transaction, hence the same is not disclosed. Transactions of remuneration with non promoter group are not required to be reported and are hence excluded.
